## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric *dhāraṇī* text attributed to **Śubhakarasiṃha** ([善無畏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%96%84%E7%84%A1%E7%95%8F)), companion to [KR6j0076](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0076) and [KR6j0077](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0077). The text gives the *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya-dhāraṇī* itself with brief ritual instructions — distinct from [KR6j0077](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0077) which gives the full ritual manual.

**Abstract**

The three-text *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya* sub-corpus ([KR6j0076](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0076)–0078) gives the Tang Esoteric tradition's framework for the *Uṣṇīṣa-vijaya* practice in three layers of detail: the doctrinal-soteriological framework ([KR6j0076](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0076)), the full ritual manual ([KR6j0077](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0077)), and the *dhāraṇī*-text proper with brief notes ([KR6j0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0078)). The structure suggests these are three editorial layers of the same practice tradition, preserved together in the Tang Esoteric corpus.

The translation dates from Śubhakarasiṃha's Chángān period (716–735).
